# Background
I ran eggnog-mapper on Ciona proteome for functional annotation. I decided to run the the proteome file from the ghost database where all proteins start with methionine. 

# Run
I ran it using the web tool at http://eggnog-mapper.embl.de

MM_z0xvzkr2
